title: On a phone, 'Make it a Connect session' runs past the right edge of the Settings card
what_happens: The Status + Privacy row wraps awkwardly: Privacy's (i) drops to its own line and the 'Make it a Connect session' button text goes outside the card border on the right.
who_hurts: An admin on a phone sees a broken-looking top row; the button is still tappable.
suggested_fix: Put Status and Privacy on separate rows below sm (flex-col sm:flex-row), and drop ml-auto on the privacy button there.
origin: this change (Privacy moved into the Status row)
